name: Raining Gorilla
summary: Raining Gorilla is a multiplayer VR horror experience inspired by Gorilla Tag movement. You and your friends are dropped into dark, creepy environments where the spookiness never stops—and neither do the horrors lurking in the shadows. Use smooth hand-based locomotion to climb, run, and escape terrifying creatures that hunt you in the dark.
